entries.title: Follow Orbis on Facebook
entries.description: Orbis now has a Facebook page that posts the weekly anime, manga, and games charts and news about each new update. Find it on the new Find us page, linked in the footer.

entries.title: Send weekly charts to Discord right away
entries.description: Community owners can now post the weekly charts to their Discord channel whenever they like with the new Send now button, instead of waiting for Monday.

entries.title: All your weekly charts in one Discord post
entries.description: When you turn on more than one chart, they now arrive together in a single Discord post with an image for each, and the preview shows exactly how it will look.

entries.title: Tidier Discord settings for communities
entries.description: Your community's Discord feed and chart posts now sit together in one Discord section, so everything about your channel is in one place.

entries.title: Shorter links to the weekly charts
entries.description: Chart posts on Discord and Facebook now use short, tidy links that take you straight to that week's chart.

entries.title: Online status stays connected during outages
entries.description: Brief server hiccups no longer drop your connection, so friends' online status keeps working instead of cutting out.
